L=/var/lib/bench68845002
# the node has the same program on JDK 11.0.13, which reads the cgroup path with its colon (JDK-8272124 is fixed there)
sudo sed -i 's#cache-app:jdk11.0.9#cache-app:jdk11.0.13#' $L/workload/container.json

L=/var/lib/bench68845002
# the asker's workaround: the JVM stops looking at the container (it then sees the memory of the host, and the environment of the container changes)
sudo python3 - <<'PY'
import json
p = "/var/lib/bench68845002/workload/container.json"
j = json.load(open(p))
j["envs"].append({"key": "JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS", "value": "-XX:-UseContainerSupport"})
json.dump(j, open(p, "w"), indent=2)
PY
sudo $L/bin/cachenodectl restart
sudo $L/bin/run-workload check

sudo $L/bin/cachenodectl restart

sudo $L/bin/cachenodectl restart

echo "probe java=11.0.9 total=536870912"
